ex.en: The internet has added a new dimension to the way we learn.
ex.zh: 互联网为我们的学习方式增添了新的层面。

words.note: dimension 可指空间尺寸，也指抽象的「方面、层面」。

ex.en: After working all night, you deserve a good rest.
ex.zh: 熬了一整夜，你该好好休息。

words.note: deserve 后接名词或不定式：deserve to win 表理应获胜。

ex.en: The data will take several days to process on this computer.
ex.zh: 在这台电脑上处理这些数据要花好几天。

words.note: in the process of 后接动名词；process 作动词表加工处理。

ex.en: He never tried to take revenge on the people who had criticized him.
ex.zh: 他从未试图报复那些批评过他的人。

words.note: take revenge on sb for sth；revenge 多为不可数名词。

ex.en: The old church has been carefully restored over the past decade.
ex.zh: 这座老教堂在过去十年里得到了精心修复。

words.note: restore 表使恢复原状，名词为 restoration。

ex.en: I subscribe to two weekly magazines and one newspaper.
ex.zh: 我订阅了两本周刊和一份报纸。

words.note: subscribe to 既可表「订阅」也可表「赞同（观点）」。

ex.en: The book distills years of research into a few clear chapters.
ex.zh: 这本书把多年研究提炼成几个清晰的章节。

words.note: 美式拼写 distill，英式 distil；distilled water 指蒸馏水。

ex.en: Cycling is a cheap alternative to driving for short trips.
ex.zh: 短途出行时，骑车是开车的廉价替代方式。

words.note: an alternative to sth 表…的替代方案；不止两个选项。

ex.en: Noise from the street makes it hard to keep my concentration.
ex.zh: 街上的噪音让我很难保持专注。

words.note: concentration 表「专注」不可数，表「浓度」可加 a。

ex.en: Scientists measured the velocity of the falling object with great accuracy.
ex.zh: 科学家们非常精确地测量了落体的速度。

words.note: velocity 为专业术语，指有方向的速率；speed 更日常。

ex.en: We encountered several problems during the first week of the project.
ex.zh: 项目第一周我们遇到了几个问题。

words.note: encounter 比 meet 正式，常接 problem、difficulty。

ex.en: She won a research fellowship that covers tuition and living costs.
ex.zh: 她获得了一项涵盖学费和生活费的研究奖学金。

words.note: fellowship 在学术语境指研究员职位或奖学金，也指情谊。

ex.en: My former colleague helped me find a job at her new company.
ex.zh: 我的前同事帮我在她的新公司找了份工作。

words.note: colleague 指职业上的同事，比 workmate 正式。

ex.en: Her parents did not approve of her decision to study abroad.
ex.zh: 她父母不赞成她出国留学的决定。

words.note: approve of 表「赞成」；approve sth 表「批准」。

ex.en: Regular social interaction helps older people stay healthy.
ex.zh: 经常进行社会交往有助于老年人保持健康。

words.note: interaction 常与 between、with 连用；动词为 interact。

ex.en: Drivers must give way to pedestrians at the crossing.
ex.zh: 在路口司机必须给行人让路。

words.note: pedestrian 指行人，也作形容词表「平淡无奇的」。

ex.en: Please do not interfere with the equipment while it is running.
ex.zh: 设备运行时请不要妨碍其运转。

words.note: interfere in 表干涉他人事务，interfere with 表妨碍某事。

ex.en: They rented a small apartment near the university.
ex.zh: 他们在大学附近租了一套小公寓。

words.note: apartment 为美式说法，英式常用 flat。

ex.en: Women account for nearly half of the students in this program.
ex.zh: 女性占这个项目学生的近一半。

words.note: account for 既可表「解释」，也可表「占（比例）」。

ex.en: The award was a fitting tribute to her thirty years of teaching.
ex.zh: 这个奖项是对她三十年教学生涯的恰当致敬。

words.note: fitting 作形容词表「恰当的」；作名词复数指设备、配件。

ex.en: There was a stack of papers waiting for him on the desk.
ex.zh: 桌上有一摞文件等着他处理。

words.note: a stack of 后接可数复数名词；stack up 表堆积起来。

ex.en: The plant must store radioactive waste safely for decades.
ex.zh: 这座工厂必须把放射性废料安全存放数十年。

words.note: radio- 表「放射」，active 表「活性的」，合指放射性的。

ex.en: She resented the fact that her work was never recognized.
ex.zh: 她对自己的工作从未得到认可这件事心怀不满。

words.note: resent 后接动名词或 that 从句，不接不定式。

ex.en: The team has made great strides in reducing production costs.
ex.zh: 这个团队在降低生产成本方面取得了很大进展。

words.note: make strides 表取得进步；stride 的过去式为 strode。

ex.en: His ambiguous answer left everyone unsure about his real plan.
ex.zh: 他模棱两可的回答让大家摸不清他的真实计划。

words.note: ambiguous 指有歧义、可多解；vague 侧重「模糊」。

ex.en: Buying that car was an impulsive decision he soon regretted.
ex.zh: 买那辆车是他一时冲动的决定，他很快就后悔了。

words.note: impulse 是名词「冲动」；impulsive 指易冲动或行为冲动。

ex.en: The study combines qualitative research with detailed interviews.
ex.zh: 这项研究把定性研究与详细访谈结合起来。

words.note: qualitative 对应 quantitative（定量的），二者成对出现。

ex.en: The city is home to people from diverse cultural backgrounds.
ex.zh: 这座城市居住着来自不同文化背景的人。

words.note: diverse 修饰复数或不可数名词；a diverse range of 高频。

ex.en: We walked through the park enjoying the crisp morning air.
ex.zh: 我们在公园里散步，享受着清冽的晨间空气。

words.note: crisp 形容食物脆、空气清冽、话语干脆；名词指薯片。

ex.en: This building is a prime example of early twentieth-century design.
ex.zh: 这座建筑是二十世纪早期设计的典型例子。

words.note: prime 表「首要的、最好的」；in one's prime 指全盛期。
